quest.title: Mimetic Replication
quest.description: Paz from Amurta seems to be busy with something...

dialogues.speaker: Paz
dialogues.text: Ah, hello there, Traveler. It would seem that you're here to take part in the Wisdom Gala.

dialogues.speaker: Paz
dialogues.text: If it would interest you, would you like to try out the game that we at Amurta have set up?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And what sort of game would that be?

dialogues.speaker: Paz
dialogues.text: Our Darshan has set up a little game called "Mimetic Replication."

dialogues.speaker: Paz
dialogues.text: In this game, I will introduce you to the behavioral patterns of certain animals.

dialogues.speaker: Paz
dialogues.text: Of course, these patterns have been simplified and generalized to make them easier to understand.

dialogues.speaker: Paz
dialogues.text: What you'll need to do is to use the models we have prepared to imitate the actions of the corresponding animals.

response.speaker: Paz
response.text: Precisely. "Animals have regular behavioral patterns" is a statement that is both simple to understand and accept.

response.speaker: Paz
response.text: But behind something so simple lie mysteries that are most deep indeed.

response.speaker: Paz
response.text: However, let us put academic observation aside for the moment and simply enjoy the habitual behaviors of animals in a relaxed manner.

choices.text: I'll give this one a go, why not?

response.speaker: Paz
response.text: Alright. In that case, please step over here.

choices.text: I've got other things to do at the moment.

response.speaker: Paz
response.text: That's fine. My booth will be open throughout the Gala, so you can come over and try the game out any time.

dialogues.speaker: Paz
dialogues.text: (If we had more funding, we'd be able to do a better job...)
